festival.en: Festivals bring our family together every year.
festival.cn: 节日每年把我们家人聚在一起。

Christmas.en: On Christmas morning, children open gifts under the tree.
Christmas.cn: 圣诞节早上，孩子们在树下拆礼物。

Spring Festival.en: We eat dumplings at Spring Festival.
At Spring Festival, we visit our relatives and get red envelopes.
Spring Festival.cn: 春节时我们走亲戚、收红包。

gift.en: Here is a gift for you.
Mum loves the small gift I made for her birthday.
gift.cn: 妈妈很喜欢我为她生日做的小礼物。

tree.en: We put colourful lights on the Christmas tree every year.
tree.cn: 我们每年在圣诞树上挂彩灯。

card.en: I send a card to her.
My friend made a beautiful card for me on my birthday.
card.cn: 我朋友在我生日时给我做了张漂亮的卡片。

dinner.en: On Christmas Eve we have a big dinner with all the family.
dinner.cn: 平安夜我们和所有家人一起吃大餐。

happy.en: Festivals make every member of our family very happy.
happy.cn: 节日让我们家每个人都很开心。
